compiled_state.title: As a reconciler developer, I want a narrow applier matrix with atomic deletion of legacy bridge modules
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Narrow applier matrix (one leaf per (direction, action) pair from draft-1 taxonomy) with rollback retry-wrap. Atomic deletion of legacy bridge modules (bridge_state/, prev_snapshot writers, mapping.json consumers, bootstrap.py, *_band.py scripts). inbound_clean_label leaf included.
**Why**: Walking-skeleton applier — the direction-tagged contract from draft-1 is only as safe as the applier that consumes it.
**Scope**:
- IN: applier.py with narrow per-(direction, action) leaves <=50 LOC each, DirectionMismatchError, UnknownActionError, rollback _call_with_retry wrap, inbound_clean_label leaf, atomic deletion of bootstrap.py + 4 *_band.py, static-import-scan
- OUT: status routing in outbound_update (gated until draft-5), probe REST GET classifier logic (draft-4 owns that; draft-2 leaf is a thin shim)

## Done Definitions

- Each (direction, action) leaf raises DirectionMismatchError when called with a Mutation whose direction does not match the leafs direction; one test per leaf ← Satisfies: sc-1
- An applier invocation with an unknown action value raises UnknownActionError and performs zero side-effects ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-2
- Rollback after a failed outbound_create invokes delete_issue through _call_with_retry with the same retry budget as create_issue; a fault-injection test forces create-then-rollback and asserts the retry envelope ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Atomic deletion: PR removes bootstrap.py, orphan_band.py, duplicates_band.py, stale_band.py, open_count_skew_band.py in a single commit; static-import-scan covers (a) plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/, (b) .github/workflows/*.yml referencing reconciler entry points, (c) tests/, (d) ripgrep across full repo for literal strings 'bootstrap', 'orphan_band', 'duplicates_band', 'stale_band', 'open_count_skew_band'. Zero remaining live imports for merge. ← Satisfies: sc-1
- inbound_clean_label applier leaf removes the dso-id-* label from a Jira issue when no matching local row exists; unit test against a captured ACLI response asserts the label-removal call payload ← Satisfies: sc-8
- outbound_update v1 handles {title, description, assignee, priority}; status routing is gated behind a feature flag/StatusMappingError-on-status-touch and lands with draft-5. Unit test: outbound_update mutation containing status payload with flag off raises StatusMappingError; with flag on routes through draft-5 mapping. ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-2
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Validates Closure Check: "TDD DoD"

## Considerations

- [Reliability/Scope] draft-1 enumerates action=probe; draft-4 emits (inbound, probe) and routes via REST GET to 4-fork classifier. Decision: draft-2 includes a (inbound, probe) applier leaf as a thin shim that delegates to draft-4 classifier. The leaf raises DirectionMismatchError on outbound input and NotImplementedError until draft-4 lands. This preserves the narrow-applier-matrix as the single dispatch surface.
- [Risk] Atomic deletion is high-blast-radius; pair this story with the residual-reference sweep (draft-10) so consumers in workflows/docs/tests are migrated in lockstep.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
